title: [SOA] Do not show duplicate-contact notification on outgoing email
summary: The Sales Order Agent no longer displays the duplicate-contact notification on outgoing email review pages, preventing users from making conflicting customer information changes after content generation.
key_points: Duplicate-contact notification is now shown only on incoming messages where it matters for customer selection
Outgoing messages no longer show the notification, avoiding confusion when recipient and content are already finalized
Change adds a type check requiring Rec.Type::Input before displaying the notification
Contact and customer information remains consistent with the generated email body and quote
No schema, data, permission or API changes, only UI refinement
quote: Shows the duplicate-contact notification only on incoming messages, where choosing the contact sets the customer the agent uses to process the request.
